verses.sloka: तमप्रतिमतेजोभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां रोमहर्षणम् ।विस्मिता: सङ्गमं प्रेक्ष्य समवेता महर्षय: ॥ २.११२.१॥
verses.transliteration: tamapratimatejobhyāṁ bhrātṛbhyāṁ romaharṣaṇam ।vismitā: saṅgamaṁ prekṣya samavetā maharṣaya: ॥ 2.112.1॥

translations.english: The great sages assembled there were amazed at witnessing the meeting of the two brothers (Rama and Bharata) of umparalleled briliance.

verses.sloka: अन्तर्हितास्त्वृषिगणा: सिद्धाश्च परमर्षय: ।तौ भ्रातरौ महात्मानौ महात्मानौ काकुत्स्थौ प्रशशंसिरे ॥ २.११२.२॥
verses.transliteration: antarhitāstvṛṣigaṇā: siddhāśca paramarṣaya: ।tau bhrātarau mahātmānau mahātmānau kākutsthau praśaśaṁsire ॥ 2.112.2॥

translations.english: The hosts of sages, siddhas and devarshis watching invisible the two Kakutstha brothers extoled them.
translations.hindi: चुत्र पिता को पुन्नाम नरक से उद्धार करता है और पितरों के उद्देश्य से इष्ठ पूत कार्यों को कर, पितरों को स्वग में भेज ' सब कार से पितरों की रक्षा करता रहता हे । इसीसे उसको पुत्र कहते हैं.

verses.sloka: स धन्यो यस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ धर्मज्ञौ धर्मविक्रमौ ।श्रुत्वा वयं हि सम्भाषामुभयो: स्पृहयामहे ॥ २.११२.३॥
verses.transliteration: sa dhanyo yasya putrau dvau dharmajñau dharmavikramau ।śrutvā vayaṁ hi sambhāṣāmubhayo: spṛhayāmahe ॥ 2.112.3॥

translations.english: On hearing their dialogue we are deeply drawn towards them, these two sons of king Dasaratha who was fortunate to have these practioners of righteousness and whose strength is dharma.

verses.sloka: ततस्त्वृषिगणा: क्षिप्रं दशग्रीववधैषिण: ।भरतं राजशार्दूलमित्यूचु: सङ्गता वच: ॥ २.११२.४॥
verses.transliteration: tatastvṛṣigaṇā: kṣipraṁ daśagrīvavadhaiṣiṇa: ।bharataṁ rājaśārdūlamityūcu: saṅgatā vaca: ॥ 2.112.4॥

translations.english: Thereafter hosts of rishis desiring the speedy destruction of tenheaded Ravana said these words to Bharata, the best of kings.

verses.sloka: कुले जात महाप्राज्ञ महावृत्त महायश: ।ग्राह्यं रामस्य वाक्यं ते पितरं यद्यवेक्षसे ॥ २.११२.५॥
verses.transliteration: kule jāta mahāprājña mahāvṛtta mahāyaśa: ।grāhyaṁ rāmasya vākyaṁ te pitaraṁ yadyavekṣase ॥ 2.112.5॥

translations.english: O Bharata, born in an illustrious race, highly sagacious and a man of virtuous conduct and great renown, accept Rama's proposal if you have any regard for your father.

verses.sloka: सदानृणमिमं रामं वयमिच्छामहे पितु: ।अनृणत्वाच्च कैकेय्या: स्वर्गं दशरथो गत: ॥ २.११२.६॥
verses.transliteration: sadānṛṇamimaṁ rāmaṁ vayamicchāmahe pitu: ।anṛṇatvācca kaikeyyā: svargaṁ daśaratho gata: ॥ 2.112.6॥

translations.english: We always desire that Rama should discharge his debt to his father. Dasaratha, who by redeeming himself of his obligation to Kaikeyi, had ascended heaven.

verses.sloka: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं गन्धर्वा: समहर्षय: ।राजर्षयश्चैव तदा सर्वे स्वांस्वां गतिं गता: ॥ २.११२.७॥
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanaṁ gandharvā: samaharṣaya: ।rājarṣayaścaiva tadā sarve svāṁsvāṁ gatiṁ gatā: ॥ 2.112.7॥

translations.english: Then the great rishis, gandharvas and royal sages having said this, returned to their respective abodes.

verses.sloka: ह्लादितस्तेन वाक्येन शुभेन शुभदर्शन: ।राम: संहृष्टवदनस्तानृषीनभ्यपूजयत् ॥ २.११२.८॥
verses.transliteration: hlāditastena vākyena śubhena śubhadarśana: ।rāma: saṁhṛṣṭavadanastānṛṣīnabhyapūjayat ॥ 2.112.8॥

translations.english: Of pleasing appearance, Rama, gladdened by the auspicious statements (of the sages), paid them homage with a cheerful countenance.

verses.sloka: स्रस्तगात्रस्तु भरत: स वाचा सज्जमानया ।कृताञ्जलिरिदं वाक्यं राघवं पुनरब्रवीत् ॥ २.११२.९॥
verses.transliteration: srastagātrastu bharata: sa vācā sajjamānayā ।kṛtāñjaliridaṁ vākyaṁ rāghavaṁ punarabravīt ॥ 2.112.9॥

translations.english: Before Bharata, with his limbs trembling and with palms folded (in reverence) was ready to depart, he said to Rama:

verses.sloka: राजधर्ममनुप्रेक्ष्य कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम् ।कर्त्तुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ मम मातुश्च याचनाम् ॥ २.११२.१०॥
verses.transliteration: rājadharmamanuprekṣya kuladharmānusantatim ।karttumarhasi kākutstha mama mātuśca yācanām ॥ 2.112.10॥

translations.english: O Rama, keeping in view the code of kings and tradition of our family, it behoves you to consider my supplication and that of my mother.

verses.sloka: रक्षितुं सुमहद्राज्यमहमेकस्तु नोत्सहे ।पौरजानपदांश्चापि रक्तान् रञ्जयितुं तथा ॥ २.११२.११॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣituṁ sumahadrājyamahamekastu notsahe ।paurajānapadāṁścāpi raktān rañjayituṁ tathā ॥ 2.112.11॥

translations.english: I do not venture to protect this kingdom all by myself and keep the inhabitants of the towns and villages who are loyal to you pleased.

verses.sloka: ज्ञातयश्च हि योधाश्च मित्राणि सुहृदश्च न: ।त्वामेव प्रतिकांक्षन्ते पर्जन्यमिव कर्षका: ॥ २.११२.१२॥
verses.transliteration: jñātayaśca hi yodhāśca mitrāṇi suhṛdaśca na: ।tvāmeva pratikāṁkṣante parjanyamiva karṣakā: ॥ 2.112.12॥

translations.english: All our relatives, warriors, friends and wellwishers long to see you like farmers yearn for the raincloud.

verses.sloka: इदं राज्यं महाप्राज्ञ स्थापय प्रतिपद्य हि ।शक्तिमानसि काकुत्स्थ लोकस्य परिपालने ॥ २.११२.१३॥
verses.transliteration: idaṁ rājyaṁ mahāprājña sthāpaya pratipadya hi ।śaktimānasi kākutstha lokasya paripālane ॥ 2.112.13॥

translations.english: O sagacious Rama, accept this kingdom and ensure its stability. You are powerful enough to govern this world. So accept this kingdom and restore its stability.
translations.hindi: पु [ नोट--इष्टापूर्त का विवरण स्मृतियों में यह लिखा है-- पूर्त--वापीकूपतडागादिदेवतायतनानि च । ` गन्प्रदानमारामाः पूर्तमर्थ्या प्रचक्तते ॥ इृष्ट--एकाग्नि कर्म हवनं तरेतायां यच हूयते । अन्तर्वेद्यां च यद्दानमिष्ट तदभिषौयत ॥ एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा युशबन्तो बहुश्र॒ताः । तेषां वै समवेतानामपि कश्चिद्गयां व्रजेत्‌

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा न्यपतद् भ्रातु: पादयोर्भरतस्तदा ।भृशं सम्प्रार्थयामास राममेव प्रियंवद: ॥ २.११२.१४॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā nyapatad bhrātu: pādayorbharatastadā ।bhṛśaṁ samprārthayāmāsa rāmameva priyaṁvada: ॥ 2.112.14॥

translations.english: Having said this, Bharata, fell at the feet of his brother, and speaking sweetly, he profusely entreated Rama.
translations.hindi: त तिन SA >. गए १ पितू,न्‌ पाति--तदुद;ं शत्र,तेशपूर्तादिना स्वलोकं प्रापस्धरुछती- _ त्य: | ( गो० ) है एवं राजषयः सर्वे प्रतीता राजनन्दन । तस्मात्‌ त्राह नरश्रष्ठ पितरं नरकात्प्रमो

verses.sloka: तमङ्के भ्रातरं कृत्वा रामो वचनमब्रवीत् ।श्यामं नलिनपत्राक्षं मत्तहंसस्वरं स्वयम् ॥ २.११२.१५॥
verses.transliteration: tamaṅke bhrātaraṁ kṛtvā rāmo vacanamabravīt ।śyāmaṁ nalinapatrākṣaṁ mattahaṁsasvaraṁ svayam ॥ 2.112.15॥

translations.english: Rama took his in his arms Bharata who had a darkblue complexion, whose eyes were like petals of lotus and whose voice was the voice of an amorous swan.
translations.hindi: सूर्य के आतप को रोकने वाले राजछत्र तुम्हारे मस्तक पर शीतल छाया करें आर मैं जङ्गल के इन पेड़ों की सघन छाया का आश्रम ग्रहण करू गा

verses.sloka: आगता त्वामियं बुद्धि: स्वजा वैनयिकी च या ।भृशमुत्सहसे तात रक्षितुं पृथिवीमपि ॥ २.११२.१६॥
verses.transliteration: āgatā tvāmiyaṁ buddhi: svajā vainayikī ca yā ।bhṛśamutsahase tāta rakṣituṁ pṛthivīmapi ॥ 2.112.16॥

translations.english: O child, this wisdom of yours is both inborn and imbibed through training. With this, you are perfectly capable of protecting the earth.
translations.hindi: इति सप्तोत्तरशततमः सगः ॥ [ हे,भरत ! यह अमितबुद्धि वाले शत्रन तुम्हारे सहायक र हैंगे ओर सर्वलोको में प्रसिद्ध यह लक्षमण मेरी सहायता करेंगे । इस प्रकार नृपश्रेष्ठ महाराज दशरथ के हम चारों पुत्र, महाराज दशरथ को सत्यवादी करें । अतः अब तुम विषादयुक्त मत _हो

verses.sloka: अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च बुद्धिमद्भिश्च मन्त्रिभि: ।सर्वकार्याणि सम्मन्त्र्य सुमहान्त्यपि कारय ॥ २.११२.१७॥
verses.transliteration: amātyaiśca suhṛdbhiśca buddhimadbhiśca mantribhi: ।sarvakāryāṇi sammantrya sumahāntyapi kāraya ॥ 2.112.17॥

translations.english: After due consultation with ministers, friends, counsellors and prudent persons, accomplish all tasks, however formidable they may appear.
translations.hindi: हे भरत ! तुम मनुष्यों के राजा हो औरं मैं वनम्गों के राजाओं का राजा हुँगा । तुम प्रसन्न हो अब श्रेष्ठ नगरी अयोध्या को गमन करो और मैं भी आनन्दपूचक दण्डकवन में प्रवेश रूगा

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रादपेयाद्वा हिमवान् वा हिमं त्यजेत् ।अतीयात् सागरो वेलां न प्रतिज्ञामहं पितु: ॥ २.११२.१८॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīścandrādapeyādvā himavān vā himaṁ tyajet ।atīyāt sāgaro velāṁ na pratijñāmahaṁ pitu: ॥ 2.112.18॥

translations.english: The Moon might lose its splendour, snow might abandon the Himavat mountain, the ocean might overstep its shores, but I shall not forsake the promise made to my father.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--भरत ने अपने कथन में जो समाधान किश्रा हे उस पर राम की उक्तियो का कुछ मी प्रकाश नहीं पड़ता । यद्यपि अन्त में चही जो भरत ने कहा था ग्रर्थात्‌ भरत ने कहा महाराज का दि हुश्रा राज्य मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ | साथ ही उस राज्य को मैं अपनी शरोर से आपको अपण करता हूँ । बात ठीक थी--कयोंकि जो बस्तु न्यायतः किसी की है--उस वस्तु को बह किसी को दे भी सकता है। यदि ऐसा न होता तो वनवास के अनन्तर राम को अयोध्या का राज्य लेना ही था । किन्तु अभी राज्य ले लेने से महाराज दशरथ का कैकेयी को दिए हुए बरदान की अवहेलना होती थी--१४ वष ,बनवास न होता । अतः मर्यादारक्षक राम ने महाराज दशरथ की बात रखी और भरत की प्रार्थना स्वीकार की | ] छायां ते दिनकरभाः प्रबाधमानं (वष त्रं भरत करोतु मूध्नि शीताम्‌ । एतेषा महमपि काननद्रुमार्णा T छ याँ तामतिशयिनी सुखी श्रयिष्ये

verses.sloka: कामाद्वा तात लोभाद्वा मात्रा तुभ्यमिदं कृतम् ।न तन्मनसि कर्त्तव्यं वर्त्तितव्यं च मातृवत् ॥ २.११२.१९॥
verses.transliteration: kāmādvā tāta lobhādvā mātrā tubhyamidaṁ kṛtam ।na tanmanasi karttavyaṁ varttitavyaṁ ca mātṛvat ॥ 2.112.19॥

translations.english: Dear brother, whether out of affection or greed, your mother has done this for your sake. It should not agitate your mind. You should conduct yourself as one should towards one's mother.

verses.sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणं भरत: कौसल्यासुतमब्रवीत् ।तेजसादित्यसङ्काशं प्रतिपच्चन्द्रदर्शनम् ॥ २.११२.२०॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ bharata: kausalyāsutamabravīt ।tejasādityasaṅkāśaṁ pratipaccandradarśanam ॥ 2.112.20॥

translations.english: On hearing this, Bharata replied to the son of Kausalya who looked like the Sun or the new Moon in brilliance:

verses.sloka: अधिरोहार्य पादाभ्यां पादुके हेमभूषिते ।एते हि सर्वलोकस्य योगक्षेमं विधास्यत: ॥ २.११२.२१॥
verses.transliteration: adhirohārya pādābhyāṁ pāduke hemabhūṣite ।ete hi sarvalokasya yogakṣemaṁ vidhāsyata: ॥ 2.112.21॥

translations.english: O noble one, place your feet on these sandals decorated with gold. They will secure the prosperity and safety of the entire world.

verses.sloka: सो ऽधिरुह्य नरव्याघ्र: पादुके ह्यवरुह्य च ।प्रायच्छत् सुमहातेजा भरताय महात्मने ॥ २.११२.२२॥
verses.transliteration: so 'dhiruhya naravyāghra: pāduke hyavaruhya ca ।prāyacchat sumahātejā bharatāya mahātmane ॥ 2.112.22॥

translations.english: Rama, the best of men, one with great brilliance, put on and then put off the sandals and presented them to the magnanimous Bharata.

verses.sloka: स पादुके सम्प्रणम्य रामं वचनमब्रवीत् ।चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि जटाचीरधरो ह्यहम् ॥ २.११२.२३॥
verses.transliteration: sa pāduke sampraṇamya rāmaṁ vacanamabravīt ।caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi jaṭācīradharo hyaham ॥ 2.112.23॥

translations.english: Bharata bowed before the sandals and said to Rama, 'O tormentorr of enemies, O hero, wearing matted locks and bark garments, living on fruits and roots, placing the responsibility of ruling the kingdom on your sandals and looking forward to your arrival, I shall reside outside the city for fourteen years.'

verses.sloka: फलमूलाशनो वीर भवेयं रघुनन्दन ।तवागमनमाकांक्षन् वसन् वै नगराद्बहि: ॥ २.११२.२४॥
verses.transliteration: phalamūlāśano vīra bhaveyaṁ raghunandana ।tavāgamanamākāṁkṣan vasan vai nagarādbahi: ॥ 2.112.24॥

translations.english: Bharata bowed before the sandals and said to Rama, 'O tormentorr of enemies, O hero, wearing matted locks and bark garments, living on fruits and roots, placing the responsibility of ruling the kingdom on your sandals and looking forward to your arrival, I shall reside outside the city for fourteen years.'

verses.sloka: तव पादुकयोर्न्यस्तराज्यतन्त्र: परन्तप ।चतुर्दशे हि सम्पूर्णे वर्षे ऽहनि रघूत्तम ।न द्रक्ष्यामि यदि त्वां तु प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम् ॥ २.११२.२५॥
verses.transliteration: tava pādukayornyastarājyatantra: parantapa ।caturdaśe hi sampūrṇe varṣe 'hani raghūttama ।na drakṣyāmi yadi tvāṁ tu pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ॥ 2.112.25॥

translations.english: O best of the Raghus, if I do not behold you on the day after completion of fourteen years I shall enter the blazing fire.

verses.sloka: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय तं परिष्वज्य सादरम् ।शत्रुघ्नं च परिष्वज्य भरतं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥ २.११२.२६॥
verses.transliteration: tatheti ca pratijñāya taṁ pariṣvajya sādaram ।śatrughnaṁ ca pariṣvajya bharataṁ cedamabravīt ॥ 2.112.26॥

translations.english: 'Be it so', assured Rama and then affectionately embracing both Bharata and Satrughna, said to Bharata:

verses.sloka: मातरं रक्ष कैकेयीं मा रोषं कुरु तां प्रति ।मया च सीतया चैव शप्तो ऽसि रघुसत्तम ॥ २.११२.२७॥
verses.transliteration: mātaraṁ rakṣa kaikeyīṁ mā roṣaṁ kuru tāṁ prati ।mayā ca sītayā caiva śapto 'si raghusattama ॥ 2.112.27॥

translations.english: Look after your mother, O chief of the Raghus Do not be angry with her. Swear in my name and in the name of Sita. So saying, eyes filled with tears, Rama took leave of his brother.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा ऽश्रुपरीताक्षो भ्रातरं विससर्ज ऺह ॥ २.११२.२८॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā 'śruparītākṣo bhrātaraṁ visasarja ऺha ॥ 2.112.28॥

translations.english: Look after your mother, O chief of the Raghus Do not be angry with her. Swear in my name and in the name of Sita. So saying, eyes filled with tears, Rama took leave of his brother.

verses.sloka: स पादुके ते भरत: प्रतापवान् स्वलङ्कृते सम्परिपूज्य धर्मवित् ।प्रदक्षिणं चैव चकार राघवं चकार चैवोत्तमनागमूर्द्धनि ॥ २.११२.२९॥
verses.transliteration: sa pāduke te bharata: pratāpavān svalaṅkṛte samparipūjya dharmavit ।pradakṣiṇaṁ caiva cakāra rāghavaṁ cakāra caivottamanāgamūrddhani ॥ 2.112.29॥

translations.english: The valiant and righteous Bharata, worshipped the welldecorated sandals and after circumambulating Rama reverentially placed them atop the best of elephants.

verses.sloka: अथानुपूर्व्यात् प्रतिनन्द्य तं जनं गुरूंश्च मन्त्रिप्रकृतीस्तथानुजौ ।व्यसर्जयद्राघववंशवर्द्धन: स्थिर: स्वधर्मे हिमवानिवाचल: ॥ २.११२.३०॥
verses.transliteration: athānupūrvyāt pratinandya taṁ janaṁ gurūṁśca mantriprakṛtīstathānujau ।vyasarjayadrāghavavaṁśavarddhana: sthira: svadharme himavānivācala: ॥ 2.112.30॥

translations.english: Inflexibly fixed in his own code of righteouness, like the Himavat mountain, Rama, the enhancer of the progeny of the Raghu dynasty, paid respect due to the preceptors, ministers and subjects in accordance with their rank, blessed his younger brothers, Bharata and Satrughna and sent them forth.

verses.sloka: तं मातरो बाष्पगृहीतकण्ठ्यो दु:खेन नामन्त्रयितुं हि शेकु: ।स त्वेव मातऽरभिवाद्य सर्वा रुदन् कुटीं स्वां प्रविवेश राम: ॥ २.११२.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ mātaro bāṣpagṛhītakaṇṭhyo du:khena nāmantrayituṁ hi śeku: ।sa tveva māta'rabhivādya sarvā rudan kuṭīṁ svāṁ praviveśa rāma: ॥ 2.112.31 ॥

translations.english: His mothers were unable to bid him farewell their throats were choked with tears of sorrow but Rama himself paid obeisance to them and entered his hut in tears. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredtwelfth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
